title: Ann's Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
steps: Brush pie crust with egg white and bake for 5 minutes, or until browned.
In a small mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.
Gradually add sweetened condensed milk and evaporated milk. Beat until smooth.
With mixer on medium speed, add lime juice and grated peel, mixing until smooth.
Pour into pie crust and freeze for at least 2 hours.
Let stand at room temperature 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
